contour_control: evaluator-only one-pixel band around the union of cached categorical silhouette boundaries

simple_contour_control.purpose: render-only high-contrast box contour motion control; not a physical trajectory
simple_contour_control.motion_contract: set box pose between renders without physics stepping; with the shared camera this is approximately 1.1 px lateral motion per 5 ms interval

multisample_contract.scope: toggle GL_MULTISAMPLE only for the existing Genesis HDR multisample framebuffer
multisample_contract.allocation: leave Genesis framebuffer sample allocation unchanged
